description: The file defines the class SugarWebServiceUtilv3, which extends SoapHelperWebServices. It contains methods for handling field filtering, relationship retrieval, module and view definitions, upcoming activities, and other SOAP web service utilities for SuiteCRM. It appears to be a utility class specific to a web service version 3 implementation within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv3
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for SOAP web service interactions such as retrieving related records, filtering fields, getting module information, and handling upcoming activities within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Returns an associative array with the field name and its value, converting Link2 instances to empty strings if __toString is not available.

methods.name: filter_fields
methods.description: Filters the list of fields based on invalid contact fields and certain field attributes, primarily used to determine which fields to include in responses.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Retrieves related bean records for a given bean through a specified relationship link, returning formatted data including filtering and date formatting.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Constructs and returns an array of module fields and link fields for a given bean, optionally translating labels, and handling special module-specific options.

methods.name: get_subpanel_defs
methods.description: Loads and returns subpanel definitions for a module based on the specified type, filtering based on user permissions.

methods.name: get_module_view_defs
methods.description: Fetches view definitions for a module, such as list or subpanel views, by loading appropriate metadata files.

methods.name: get_visible_modules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are enabled and accessible within the application, based on user permissions and system tabs.

methods.name: get_upcoming_activities
methods.description: Aggregates soon-to-happen activities like meetings, calls, tasks, and opportunities for the current user, returning a sorted list of upcoming items.

methods.name: generateUpcomingActivitiesWhereClause
methods.description: Constructs a SQL WHERE clause to fetch upcoming activities based on date, user, and status filters.

methods.name: format_upcoming_activities_entries
methods.description: Formats a list of bean objects into an array suitable for SOAP responses, extracting id, module, date_due, and summary.

methods.name: cmp_datedue
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting activities by their due date in ascending order.
